parameters.content: from unittest import TestCase from mistune import create_markdown from tests.perf_utils import assert_near_linear class TestAutoseIssue2Fr002(TestCase): def test_url_plugin_trailing_question_mark(self): """AC-FR-002-1: Given Markdown input "did you try https://example.com/docs?", when markdown is created with plugins=["url"], then output HTML contains https://example.com/docs?.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("did you try https://example.com/docs?") self.assertIn('https://example.com/docs?', result) def test_url_plugin_trailing_exclamation_mark(self): """AC-FR-002-2: Given Markdown input "check https://example.com/path! for info", when markdown is created with plugins=["url"], then output HTML contains https://example.com/path!.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) result = md("check https://example.com/path! for info") self.assertIn('https://example.com/path!', result) def test_url_plugin_performance_linear(self): """AC-NFR-001-1: Execution time is O(n) relative to text length for URL parsing.""" md = create_markdown(plugins=["url"]) def render(size): text = " ".join(f"https://example.com/path/{i}?" for i in range(size)) return md(text) assert_near_linear(self, render, 1000, 2000)
